errors.evidence: The description states that the Oracle line starts around 1900, but the chart shows it starting at a value between 1000 and 2000, approximately 1500-1600.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the MySQL line as dark blue ("тъмносиня"). According to the legend and the chart, the MySQL line is black.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the MongoDB line as dark blue ("тъмносиня"). According to the legend and the chart, the MongoDB line is purple.
The description states that the MongoDB line reaches a score of about 150 by 2020, but the chart clearly shows it reaching a score of approximately 400.
The description claims the IBM Db2 line moves upward ("се движи нагоре"), but the chart shows a slight downward trend for this line over the period.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the Redis line as dark brown ("тъмнокоричнева"). According to the legend and the chart, the Redis line is yellow.
The description claims the Redis line starts at a score of around 100, but the chart shows it starting much lower, at approximately 30.
The description states that the Redis line reaches a score of about 150 by 2020, but the chart shows it ending at a score of approximately 110-120.

The description identifies the SQLite line as dark pink ("тъмнорозова"). While the color is a shade of red, the legend clearly labels it as SQLite, and this description is inconsistent with other color descriptions.
The description states the SQLite line reaches a score of about 150 by 2020, but the chart shows it ending at a score of approximately 100.
The description states the Cassandra line reaches a score of about 150 by 2020, but the chart shows it ending at a score of approximately 100.
